Definition: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
BiblicalUsage: Judah is the name of five Israelites, and of the tribe and the territory that came from the first of them, the son of Jacob. In Genesis 29:35, therefore she called his name Judah. The fuller story is told on the Judah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Judah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
